item.title: Your reminders arrive every time
item.summary: Daily and weekly reminders now send every time they're scheduled, even when you don't reply.
item.details: Murph no longer adds a question about keeping, changing, or pausing a reminder you haven't answered, and it no longer goes quiet after a few quiet days. A reminder stops or changes only when you ask. If you've already told Murph you did the thing, it still skips that one reminder.
